no_preview_declaration: No seed in 160001..160036 (sealed eval block) or 170001..170200 (reserved train block) has ever been instantiated, previewed, counted for eligibility, smoke-tested, or debugged with, on any generator family or in any pipeline stage. A repository-wide search of the working tree and all git history before this seal found each block only as inert textual declarations in the protocol, runner, tests, and this seal, plus coincidental digit collisions inside retained float values of prior result artifacts. ERRATA (declared per the protocol): the first declared train block 150001..150200 was voided pre-seal — the runner's test suite, written under an instruction that predated the protocol's train-block no-preview rule, instantiated the prefix 150001..150010 in a training fixture before any commit; the consistency audit caught it before commit A, no seal existed, no run happened, no claims were computed. The block was replaced by 170001..170200, verified absent. Tests now instantiate only the sanctioned fixture seeds (70001..70005, 70501..70540, 70601..70620) or hand-built fixtures. If even one seed of either block is accidentally instantiated in its role before execution, the affected block is void and a new block must be chosen and verified absent.

primary_family.theta: mean over eligible seeds of [condition-mean correctness(arch-full) - condition-mean correctness(generic-mlp)], each a mean of the seed's three condition indicators
primary_family.support_rule: supported iff the one-sided Bonferroni lower bound (alpha = 0.05/4, Student-t critical value for the eligible n) exceeds 0 (the full architecture beats the no-architecture model end to end)

primary_family.theta: mean over eligible seeds of [condition-mean correctness(arch-full) - condition-mean correctness(routing-only)]
primary_family.support_rule: supported iff the one-sided Bonferroni lower bound exceeds 0 (the discovery head's measured contribution; routing-only fails out-of-library by construction)

primary_family.theta: mean over eligible seeds of [correct(arch-full) - correct(generic-mlp)] on the in-library condition
primary_family.support_rule: supported iff the one-sided Bonferroni lower bound exceeds 0 (strict; a tie fails the claim and is reported as frozen)

primary_family.theta: mean over eligible seeds of [correct(arch-full) - correct(discovery-only)] on the in-library condition
primary_family.support_rule: supported iff the one-sided Bonferroni lower bound exceeds -0.05 (bounded harm, not superiority: the alarm path costs no accuracy vs always-discovering; invocation counts and wall times are descriptive)

stop_rules: Any preflight mismatch: seal-validation failure (unknown seal key at any level including inside a claim object, descriptive claim subfields missing or blank, tampered claim field, design_commit absent from history or not an ancestor of HEAD, the imported universa package not resolving under the project's src), hash mismatch, seal not committed at HEAD, on-disk seal not byte-identical to its HEAD blob, symlinked seal/protocol/runner, dirty worktree, existing output path, available CUDA, or torch thread count other than one.

A worktree found dirty, a code-manifest hash found changed, or the on-disk seal, protocol, or runner file found changed at the end-of-run publication guard (a classified design_failure with a preserved artifact, never a bare traceback).
A raw-row count violating the frozen invariant 4 arms x 3 conditions x |eligible seeds|.
An instance-build exception: whole-run design_failure, never an exclusion; the offending seed is recorded, the run stops, no seed is ever deleted alone.
Fewer than 30 eligible seeds (the build and the undegraded audit): design_failure_insufficient_eligible with no training and no claims.
Any determinism failure (including the double-execution bit-identity check), NaN, audit (other than the per-seed eligibility gate), rank, or validation failure: whole-run design_failure.
Aggregation failure or a non-finite estimand.
Any manual cancellation or infrastructure interruption: interrupted.
No outcome-dependent stopping, no interim analysis, no sample-size extension, no seed-level deletion.
Never rerun because results are surprising, weak, null, or apparently decisive; any code, tolerance, dependency, or analysis change after a partial run invalidates the seed block.
